concept.hr: Razred u rundama gradi deterministički konačni automat za zadani jezik
concept.en: A class builds a deterministic finite automaton for a given language in rounds

summary.hr: Presenter zada jezik, svaki igrač u rundi preda jedan potez, a nakon runde automat se provjeri na testnim riječima i dobije protuprimjer.
summary.en: The presenter sets a language, each player submits one move per round, and after each round the automaton is tested on words and given a counterexample.
